label: Frail
description: Recovering from a mortal wound. You get no natural healing and no nightly System Strain recovery, and another drop to 0 HP kills you. A week of bed rest or magical healing ends it.

label: Prone
description: On the ground. You must spend movement to stand, can only crawl at half speed, take -4 on melee attacks, and are easier to hit in melee and harder to hit at range.

label: Grappled
description: Held by another creature. Neither of you can move away, only unarmed attacks are possible, and each round the holder may hurt you. A successful opposed check breaks free.

label: Unconscious
description: Insensible and helpless. You cannot act or perceive, and an attacker may treat you as a defenseless target. Rousing you takes damage, a Main Action, or time.
